{"code":500,"data":null,"message":"
Invalid `this.prisma.portfolio.findUnique()` invocation in
/app/src/apps/portfolio/portfolio.service.ts:201:51

  198 
  199 /** 验证 portfolioId 归属当前用户，不属于则抛出 403/404 */
  200 async assertOwner(portfolioId: string, userId: number) {
→ 201   const portfolio = await this.prisma.portfolio.findUnique({
          where: {
            id: undefined,
        ?   AND?: PortfolioWhereInput | PortfolioWhereInput[],
        ?   OR?: PortfolioWhereInput[],
        ?   NOT?: PortfolioWhereInput | PortfolioWhereInput[],
        ?   userId?: IntFilter | Int,
        ?   name?: StringFilter | String,
        ?   description?: StringNullableFilter | String | Null,
        ?   initialCash?: DecimalFilter | Decimal,
        ?   createdAt?: DateTimeFilter | DateTime,
        ?   updatedAt?: DateTimeFilter | DateTime,
        ?   user?: UserScalarRelationFilter | UserWhereInput,
        ?   holdings?: PortfolioHoldingListRelationFilter,
        ?   riskRules?: PortfolioRiskRuleListRelationFilter,
        ?   violations?: RiskViolationLogListRelationFilter,
        ?   tradeLogs?: PortfolioTradeLogListRelationFilter,
        ?   alertRules?: PriceAlertRuleListRelationFilter
          }
        })

Argument `where` of type PortfolioWhereUniqueInput needs at least one of `id` arguments. Available options are marked with ?."}
